newsitem.title: USA: Shell says Mars producing 86,000 bpd oil.
newsitem.headline: Shell says Mars producing 86,000 bpd oil.

text.p: Shell Oil, operator of the Mars property in deepwater Gulf of Mexico, said Tuesday that the oilfield is currently producing 86,000 barrel per day (bpd) of crude oil.
"We currently have six wells producing on Mars," a Shell spokeswoman told Retuers.

"We are very pleased with the individual well rates, which range from 13,000 to 18,000 bpd. As of yesterday (April 7) Mars is producing 86,000 bpd and 94 million cubic feet of a day (mmcfd) of (natural) gas," the spokeswoman said.

"We are optimistic that we will be achieving our expected production rate, of 100,000 bpd of oil and 110 mmcfd of gas, during this quarter. It has taken a little longer than we had expected," she added, but there were no significant problems with the development.
